quarterly_data.quarter: Ginkgo Bioworks press release: Ginkgo Bioworks Expands Autonomous Lab Network to Caltech, (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Deployment sizes for the four academic autonomous-lab nodes: Ginkgo plans to deploy approximately 11 RACs plus Catalyst Software at the University of Maryland CRAB Lab (automated, cloud-accessible biomanufacturing suite with a digital-twin sandbox) and anticipates deploying five RACs at Northwestern's DREAM Cloud Lab; it expects to provide RACs and Catalyst Software at Caltech (ELECTRA) and RACs at the MIT Media Lab cloud laboratory. Caltech, UMD and Northwestern were selected under the NSF PCL Test Bed program; MIT's node is funded by a Massachusetts Life Sciences Center grant.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 11 RACs (University of Maryland); five RACs (Northwestern)
